nodes.text: INSTANT · ON-DEVICE AI This file, "constitution-9pages.pdf," is a United States Constitutional document detailing the structure of the legislative and executive branches. Its main points are: • Legislative: The Senate selects Senators (6-year terms via writs); Representatives are apportioned by population (free service + bound). • Executive: The President elects himself from states, requires at least 35 years of age; serves four-year terms with a VP chosen to ensure a majority. No state imposes duties/taxes on imports/exports without Congressional consent. • Treason & Taxation: Treason is defined as levying war or aiding enemies; no person can be convicted unless there are two witnesses to the act or a confession in court, and no tax may be imposed on import unless it does not exceed $10 per person (Section 9). No "Attainder of Treason" shall pass without the consent of other States. Summary of all 9 pages. INSTANT can miss or mix up details of a long file; FAST summarizes files better.
